summary: UI pages no longer break after an update with a blank page and a missing-export error in the console.
details: The app served UI script files without a cache directive, so the browser could reuse an old copy of one file next to a freshly downloaded copy of another.
A mismatched pair stopped the page from loading at all; the DFM method window was the most recent to hit it.
UI assets are now revalidated against the server on every load, so an updated file is always picked up.
